facts.text: NaClient is the analyzer client class; its constructor stores host and port and defaults the port to 5025
A session is a raw TCP socket to host:port with a 10 s connect timeout and a default 180 s I/O timeout
Every SCPI command is sent as ASCII terminated by a newline
identify opens a short-lived session, queries *IDN? and closes the session
The supported identity gate accepts Keysight PNA/N522/N523/N524/N526/N529 and Rohde & Schwarz ZVA/ZVB/ZVT identities only
capture accepts only 1, 2 or 4 ports and rejects every other port count before opening a session
capture reads *IDN? and dispatches to the Keysight or the Rohde & Schwarz capture sequence
The Keysight capture selects the measurement, starts a single sweep, saves a Touchstone file and transfers it back with MMEM:TRAN?
The Rohde & Schwarz capture turns continuous sweep off, starts an immediate sweep and saves/transfers a Touchstone file
configure_measurements adds missing Keysight S-parameter measurements without replacing existing ones
configure_measurements refuses non-Keysight analyzers without changing analyzer state
abort_active_session closes the active I/O session; it sends no SCPI abort command
The upstream validates a received Touchstone payload before atomically replacing the target file
The default capture file name is a timestamped MKTrace name with the .s1p, .s2p or .s4p suffix
The README says the MKCal calibration workflow is simulator-only
The README says the automated tests do not contact real hardware
